userPromptSubmitted.bash: in=$(cat); [ "$COPILOT_MIN_ADAPTER" = 1 ] && exit 0; case $in in *'"parentAgentId"'*) exit 0;; esac; sid=${in#*'"sessionId":"'}; ts=${in#*'"timestamp":'}; m="${COPILOT_HOME:-$HOME/.copilot}/session-state/${sid%%'"'*}/minprompt.$PPID"; case " $(ps -o args= -p $PPID) " in *' --acp '*) echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Plain copilot --acp does not load the minimal setup. Use copilot-min --acp instead."}'; exit 0;; *' -p '*|*' --prompt'*) [ -e "$m" ] && exit 0;; esac; [ "${ts%%[,\}]*}" -ge "$(cat "$m" 2>/dev/null)" ] 2>/dev/null || echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"Minimal prompt not loaded yet. Send your prompt again."}'
